# Incident Response

## PowerShell Execution With Encoded Command

**Technique:** [T1059.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/) · **Rule:** [`T1059.001_powershell_encoded_command`](../T1059.001_powershell_encoded_command/)

| Role | Action |
|---|---|
| SOC L2 | Review 4104 script blocks, child processes, network connections and DNS from the PowerShell process (±30 minutes) |
| Incident response | Block contacted infrastructure, remove persistence created by the script, isolate the host if a second stage ran |

### Evidence to collect
- Full command line and decoded script
- 4104 script blocks
- Parent process tree
- Network connections and DNS queries from the process

### Containment
1. Block the remote host or domain seen in the script
2. Isolate the host if a second stage executed
3. Remove any persistence created by the script
